requirement.statement: Bun OM SHALL implement the .NET V1 behavior catalog, canonical JSON manifest, callback binding identity and derived readiness contract without persisting executable callback source.

case.given: An equivalent behavior catalog in Bun and .NET
case.when: Each implementation encodes the V1 manifest
case.then: The UTF-8 bytes SHALL be identical, deterministic and free of executable source

case.given: A malformed or semantically invalid V1 manifest
case.then: Bun SHALL return the matching OMM diagnostic codes, paths and stable order

case.given: A persisted callback binding identity and a runtime registry
case.then: Readiness SHALL be unbound, unresolved or ready solely from the persisted identity and exact runtime registration

case.given: Two runtimes share one database and therefore the same binding facts
case.when: Only one runtime registers the exact callback
case.then: Only that runtime SHALL be ready and executable

case.given: A bound callback is absent or has a mismatched identity
case.when: Constraint, validator, computed, action, parent action, mutation or interceptor resolution reaches it
case.then: Execution SHALL fail with OMR1001 before any earlier pipeline callback or partial effect runs

case.given: A native callback was defined without a binding identity
case.when: It is executed through an existing Bun API
case.then: It SHALL remain unbound and executable for compatibility

case.given: Valid metadata contains callbacks unavailable in the runtime
case.then: Metadata and bindings SHALL commit, unresolved callbacks SHALL remain inactive, and execution SHALL fail closed

case.given: Any required callback is unavailable or incompatible
case.then: The import SHALL be rejected without metadata, binding or registry effects

case.given: Persistence commits but runtime registry publication fails
case.then: The previous persistent state SHALL be restored or an explicit incomplete-compensation error SHALL be returned
